{"metadata":{"description":"Outbound LLM request modification for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), at the fetch transport layer.","id":"gh:1335055853","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-custom-header","slug":"Asaiuta/dsh-custom-header","topics":["anthropic","claude-code","codex","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","fetch","header-injection","http","llm","middleware","opencode","plugin","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Outbound LLM request modification for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), at the fetch transport layer."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-custom-header"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Outbound LLM request modification for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), at the fetch transport layer.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"One `globalThis.fetch` middleware chain (keyed by a DSH-scoped symbol,
`Symbol.for("dsh-custom-heade"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"r.fetch.pipeline.v1")`) that every provider —
whatever plugin owns it — streams through:"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **injects** client-identity headers (`User-Agent`, `Originator`,
`X-Claude-Code-Session-Id`, `x-op"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"encode-*`, …) from presets that mirror real
Codex / Claude Code / opencode clients
- **strips** `X-S"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"tainless-*` runtime fingerprint headers
- **rewrites** the request URL (path matching + `appendQuery"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"`)
- **patches** request bodies: the Anthropic Messages identity / billing system
block + `metadata."},{"id":"p5s5","text":"user_id`, and the opencode Zen free-tier tool stubs"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> For servers you administer or are authorized to use. Cloudflare TLS/Bot
> edge blocks need a diffe"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rent API entry, an admin allowlist, or a local
> forward proxy."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why fetch, not a provider-owning adapter"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The 0.2/0.3 line rewrote this plugin as provider-owning `LlmAdapter`s
registered through `ctx.llm.re"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"gisterAdapter(routes, adapter)`. That extension
point is **per-route exclusive**: registering a rout"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"e another plugin already
owns (say the `ziyong`/`moonshotai` providers that `llm-pi-ai` registers)
t"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"hrows `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER`, and the host exposes no way to graft onto someone
else's adapter. The poi"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"nt of this plugin is exactly "make requests to *my*
gateway look like client X" — whatever plugin th"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ose requests come from — so it
needs a seat that owns no routes at all. The fetch layer is that seat"},{"id":"p8s7","text":": it
intercepts the transport every adapter already uses."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The cost of the fetch seat is that only the request URL identifies a request
(never the owning provi"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"der). So the `gatewayHosts` allowlist is the single safety
boundary: **every profile — fixed ones in"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"cluded — touches only requests whose
host matches**, and an empty allowlist is a safe no-op."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`apply` registers four middlewares into the shared pipeline, each re-reading a
snapshot that `loader"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"/volatile-update` refreshes (a settings save therefore
lands in the next request — no restart):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| priority | middleware | what it does |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| 5 | `url-rewrite` | path matching + `appendQuery` / replacement, host-gated |
| 6 | `header-strip`"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" | `X-Stainless-*` and runtime fingerprint removal, on profiles that ask for it |
| 7 | `header-inje"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ct` | the resolved profile's identity headers + `extraHeaders` |
| 8 | `body-patch` | Anthropic iden"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"tity body patch; opencode Zen `/zen` → `/inference` + `bash`/`read` tool stubs (free models only) |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The chain mechanics: an accessor `fetch` on `globalThis` whose setter keeps the
underlying fetch in "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"sync; middlewares compose on every (re)install, priority
ascending; each receives `{ input, init, ne"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"xt }` and may call `next` with
rewritten input. The pipeline is vendored from
`@aizigao/pi-fetch-pip"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"eline`
(MIT), re-keyed for DSH so multiple plugins can coexist without clobbering each
other's chain"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ine`
(MIT), re-keyed for DSH so multiple plugins can coexist without clobbering each
other's chains."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Session-scoped ids (`x-opencode-session`, `X-Claude-Code-Session-Id`,
`metadata.user_id`) cannot be "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"read from a URL, so the plugin wraps the
`llm/stream` waterfall: every adapter stream iteration — in"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"cluding the fetch it
issues — runs inside an `AsyncLocalStorage` carrying
`GenerateOptions.sessionId"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"`. That is what keeps concurrent DSH conversations
from sharing one process-wide id. The same observ"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"er logs a 403 hint
distinguishing Cloudflare HTML edge blocks from JSON client-restriction
rejection"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" logs a 403 hint
distinguishing Cloudflare HTML edge blocks from JSON client-restriction
rejections."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Configuration is a schemastery `Config` schema on the plugin, validated by the

`describe()` collects only entries carrying a volatile field, and it"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"s writer
rejects any other path. A volatile-only change is committed into the running
fiber rather t"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"han remounting it — the host half re-reads its refs on
`loader/volatile-update` instead of snapshott"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"g it — the host half re-reads its refs on

| `codex_claude_plugin` | `Claude Code/0.5.0 (Macos 15.5; arm64) iTerm2.app` + `Origin"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ator: Claude Code` |

| `claude_code_messages` | `claude-cli/2.1.220 (external, sdk-cli)` + `X-C"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"laude-Code-Session-Id` + full `anthropic-beta` + body (`metadata.user_id` JSON / system block) |
| `"},{"id":"p21s8","text":"opencode_zen` | `opencode/1.19.0 ai-sdk/...` UA + `x-opencode-client/project/session/session-id/requ"},{"id":"p21s9","text":"est` (descending `ses_` id) |
| `auto` | on a matching host: Anthropic `/v1/messages` paths → Claude"},{"id":"p21s10","text":" set; anything else → `codexFallback` |
| `off` | nothing |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"All profiles — fixed ones included — are gated by `gatewayHosts`. The Codex header
